We are looking for a forward\-thinking intern who lives at the intersection of Human Resources, Process Architecture, and Artificial Intelligence. You won't just be managing paperwork; you will be the architect of our digital transformation. Your mission is twofold: optimizing our talent acquisition engine using **Gem AI and Greenhouse**, and mapping the **"Rubrik Journey"** by streamlining workflows and building a world\-class internal knowledge base.

* **Data\-Driven Insights:** Create dashboards to track the efficacy of AI\-driven sourcing and identify "moments of truth" in the employee lifecycle to boost retention.
* **Enablement:** Create "How\-To" guides and lead training sessions for the global team on new AI features and standardized SOPs.

This role offers the unique opportunity to work on meaningful projects that directly impact our employees and business success while learning from industry\-leading HR professionals.
   

  

 Youll develop core HR competencies alongside dedicated mentors within Amazons culture of ownership and excellence. The position provides hands\-on experience across human resources functions, including employee relations, training, compensation, and workforce analytics, all while building fundamental skills in a fast\-paced, global environment.
   

  

 Successful candidates will demonstrate strong analytical capabilities, excellent communication skills, and a data\-driven approach to problem\-solving. This internship positions you at the intersection of people and business strategy, providing valuable experience in one of the worlds most innovative companies.
   

  

 Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Developing in\-depth knowledge of HR functions within Amazons fast\-paced operations
* Assisting with internal communication efforts to align teams across multiple countries, promoting collaboration and information\-sharing
* Helping develop training plans and materials to address the evolving development needs of various teams, supporting employee growth
* Learning about HR functions across the broader Amazon organization and staying up\-to\-date on best practices
* Providing support to Amazon employees on a range of daily queries related to attendance, engagement, compensation, and other HR matters
* Assisting HR teams with day\-to\-day operational routines and administrative tasks
* Participating in process reviews to identify opportunities for simplification and automation, driving efficiency improvements
* Compiling comprehensive personnel statistics, reports, and performance evaluations to inform decision\-making
* Partnering closely with business leaders to align HR strategies and initiatives with organizational goals and priorities


 A day in the life
   

  

 This internship will immerse you in HR within a global organization. You may have the opportunity to work on projects in different HR (human resources) areas, like employee relations, training, or compensation. As an intern, youll have the chance to apply your analytical, problem\-solving, and technical skills, as well as develop important communication and other professional soft skills, through hands\-on experience.
   

  

 Youll gain insights into how HR partners with the business to drive growth and organizational excellence. The experience you acquire will be invaluable as you embark on your HR career, providing a strong foundation in a fast\-paced, global setting.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Intern Community:
   

  

 As an Amazon Intern, youll be part of a supportive community that empowers your growth and development. Youll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.

 Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, youll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.

 We are hiring interns to start on standardized dates from January through July 2026\. Each month, well hold 1\-2 onboarding days for new hires.

* Currently in your penultimate (graduating in 2027\) or last year and working towards a university (Bachelor or Master) degree in HR, Business Administration, Social Sciences, Law or a related field (Humanities focused), or a similar discipline.

**Project Role Description :** Define the cloud security framework and architecture, ensuring it meets the business requirements and performance goals. Document the implementation of the cloud security controls and transition to cloud security\-managed operations.
  

**Must have skills :** SailPoint IdentityNow  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **7\.5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

The SailPoint IIQ SME serves as the organization s primary technical authority on Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), leading the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Identitynow platform to ensure secure, compliant, and efficient identity lifecycle management.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

* Platform Ownership \& Architecture
* Serve as the technical lead and go\-to expert for all SailPoint IIQ deployments, upgrades, and integrations
* Design and maintain the IIQ architecture including connectors, workflows, rules, and role models
* Lead platform upgrades, patch management, and environment migrations (Dev ,QA ,Prod)
* Identity Governance
* Define and implement Joiner\-Mover\-Leaver (JML) lifecycle processes
* Build and manage Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) frameworks and entitlement catalogs
* Develop and maintain Separation of Duties (SoD) policies and conflict matrices
* Access Certification \& Compliance
* Design and run access certification/recertification campaigns
* Ensure alignment with regulatory frameworks such as SOX, HIPAA, GDPR, ISO 27001, and PCI\-DSS
* Support internal and external audits by producing IIQ compliance reports and evidence packages
* Connector \& Integration Development
* Develop and maintain connectors for applications including Active Directory, LDAP, SAP, Workday, ServiceNow, Azure AD, and custom apps
* Integrate IIQ with ITSM, HRMS, and PAM tools via REST/SOAP APIs and flat\-file feeds
* Customization \& Development
* Write and maintain BeanShell/Java rules, custom workflows, email templates, and task definitions
* Develop custom reports and dashboards using Jasper Reports or IIQ s native reporting engine
* Governance \& Documentation
* Maintain solution design documents, runbooks, and operational guides
* Define IAM policies, standards, and best practices for the organization
* Stakeholder Engagement
* Collaborate with business owners, application teams, HR, and security to gather and translate requirements into IIQ configurations
* Provide training and knowledge transfer to L1/L2 support teams
* Act as the escalation point for complex IAM incidents and service requests

  

  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

* Experience in IAM, hands\-on SailPoint IIQ
* IIQ Modules LCM, Compliance Manager, Workflows, Role Management, Provisioning
* Development BeanShell, Java, XML, REST/SOAP APIs
* Directories Active Directory, LDAP, Azure AD
* Connectors SAP, Workday, ServiceNow, Oracle, flat\-file, JDBC
* Compliance SOX, HIPAA, GDPR, PCI\-DSS audit support
* Databases MySQL, MS SQL, or Oracle (for IIQ backend)
* Platforms Linux/Windows server environments, Tomcat application server
* SailPoint Certified Identitynow Engineer or Architect certification
* Experience with SailPoint IdentityNow (cloud) or IIQ\-to\-IDN migration
* Familiarity with CyberArk, BeyondTrust, or other PAM tools
* Exposure to Zero Trust architecture principles
* ITIL Foundation certification
* Experience in large\-scale enterprise environments (10,000\+ identities)

  

Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 7\.5 years of experience in SailPoint Identitynow.
* This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

* Develop custom reports and dashboards using Jasper Reports or IIQ s native reporting engine

* Act as the escalation point for complex IAM incidents and service requests

* IIQ Modules LCM, Compliance Manager, Workflows, Role Management, Provisioning
* Development BeanShell, Java, XML, REST/SOAP APIs
* Directories Active Directory, LDAP, Azure AD

* Compliance SOX, HIPAA, GDPR, PCI\-DSS audit support
* Databases MySQL, MS SQL, or Oracle (for IIQ backend)
* Platforms Linux/Windows server environments, Tomcat application server
* SailPoint Certified Identitynow Engineer or Architect certification
* Experience with SailPoint IdentityNow (cloud) or IIQ\-to\-IDN migration
* Familiarity with CyberArk, BeyondTrust, or other PAM tools
* Exposure to Zero Trust architecture principles
* ITIL Foundation certification
* Experience in large\-scale enterprise environments (10,000\+ identities)

  

Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 7\.5 years of experience in SailPoint Identitynow.
* This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: Security Architect
description:
**Project Role :** Security Architect  

**Project Role Description :** Define the cloud security framework and architecture, ensuring it meets the business requirements and performance goals. Document the implementation of the cloud security controls and transition to cloud security\-managed operations.
  

**Must have skills :** SailPoint IdentityIQ  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **7\.5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

The SailPoint IIQ SME serves as the organization s primary technical authority on Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), leading the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of the IdentityIQ platform to ensure secure, compliant, and efficient identity lifecycle management.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

* Platform Ownership \& Architecture
* Serve as the technical lead and go\-to expert for all SailPoint IIQ deployments, upgrades, and integrations
* Design and maintain the IIQ architecture including connectors, workflows, rules, and role models
* Lead platform upgrades, patch management, and environment migrations (Dev QA Prod)
* Identity Governance
* Define and implement Joiner\-Mover\-Leaver (JML) lifecycle processes
* Build and manage Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) frameworks and entitlement catalogs
* Develop and maintain Separation of Duties (SoD) policies and conflict matrices
* Access Certification \& Compliance
* Design and run access certification/recertification campaigns
* Ensure alignment with regulatory frameworks such as SOX, HIPAA, GDPR, ISO 27001, and PCI\-DSS
* Support internal and external audits by producing IIQ compliance reports and evidence packages
* Connector \& Integration Development
* Develop and maintain connectors for applications including Active Directory, LDAP, SAP, Workday, ServiceNow, Azure AD, and custom apps
* Integrate IIQ with ITSM, HRMS, and PAM tools via REST/SOAP APIs and flat\-file feeds
* Customization \& Development
* Write and maintain BeanShell/Java rules, custom workflows, email templates, and task definitions
* Develop custom reports and dashboards using Jasper Reports or IIQ s native reporting engine
* Governance \& Documentation
* Maintain solution design documents, runbooks, and operational guides
* Define IAM policies, standards, and best practices for the organization
* Stakeholder Engagement
* Collaborate with business owners, application teams, HR, and security to gather and translate requirements into IIQ configurations
* Provide training and knowledge transfer to L1/L2 support teams
* Act as the escalation point for complex IAM incidents and service requests

  

  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

* Experience in IAM, with 5–7\+ years hands\-on SailPoint IIQ
* IIQ Modules LCM, Compliance Manager, Workflows, Role Management, Provisioning
* Development BeanShell, Java, XML, REST/SOAP APIs
* Directories Active Directory, LDAP, Azure AD
* Connectors SAP, Workday, ServiceNow, Oracle, flat\-file, JDBC
* Compliance SOX, HIPAA, GDPR, PCI\-DSS audit support
* Databases MySQL, MS SQL, or Oracle (for IIQ backend)
* Platforms Linux/Windows server environments, Tomcat application server
* SailPoint Certified IdentityIQ Engineer or Architect certification
* Experience with SailPoint IdentityNow (cloud) or IIQ\-to\-IDN migration
* Familiarity with CyberArk, BeyondTrust, or other PAM tools
* Exposure to Zero Trust architecture principles
* ITIL Foundation certification
* Experience in large\-scale enterprise environments (10,000\+ identities)

  

Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 7\.5 years of experience in SailPoint IdentityIQ.
* This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

  

15 years full time education

 **3\. Data Modelling \& Business Intelligence Development*** Lead data discovery, develop, and maintain moderately complex ETL processes in GCP / SQL for extracting, transforming data from diverse data sources as per business problem needs.

* Review and provide feedback on the work of Analysts and Senior Analysts, ensuring high\-quality deliverables.

2\. **Experience:** 5\+ years of experience in data development, analysis, or visualization, with demonstrated technical acumen.

* Proficiency in **Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Advanced Excel, Tableau, and SQL Server**.

* Lease population completeness and contract data integrity
* Accurate ROU asset and lease liability accounting
* Lease reconciliations are timely certified in OneStream
* Full compliance with SOX / ICFR / IPE standards


The role owns lease accounting governance, close readiness, and control discipline, ensuring consistent, audit\-ready outcomes across NIQ entities.

**Role Purpose**


To deliver accurate, controlled, and compliant lease accounting outcomes by:

* Owning lease accounting lifecycle integrity and governance
* Driving high\-quality reconciliations and certification discipline
* Ensuring complete and accurate lease population and contract inputs
* Leading teams and stakeholders to achieve predictable, first\-time\-right close execution

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end\-to\-end lease accounting lifecycle and close execution
* Govern:
* Close calendar
* Readiness
* Cutover activities
* Ensure timely and accurate:
* Lease accounting
* OneStream certification

  

2\. Lease Population \& Data Integrity

* Ensure completeness and accuracy of lease population
* Govern lease data inputs including:
* Contract terms
* Payment schedules
* Modifications and updates
* Maintain strong controls over master data integrity

  

3\. Accounting Accuracy (ROU \& Lease Liability)

* Ensure accurate accounting for:
* ROU assets
* Lease liabilities
* Govern accounting treatment for:
* Lease modifications
* Remeasurements
* Discount rate changes
* Ensure consistent application of IFRS 16 / ASC 842 standards

  

4\. Reconciliation \& Certification Governance

* Ensure lease tool\-to\-GL reconciliations are complete and accurate
* Drive timely OneStream certification with strong tie\-out discipline
* Maintain high standards of:
* Documentation
* Evidence traceability
* Validation controls

  

5\. Controls, Compliance \& Audit

* Ensure compliance with:
* SOX / ICFR controls
* IPE evidence standards
* Maintain audit\-ready lease accounting processes and documentation
* Support and lead internal and external audit engagements
* Ensure traceability of:
* Accounting outputs
* Approvals
* Supporting evidence

  

6\. Lease Modifications \& Remeasurements Governance

* Govern processing of:
* Lease modifications
* Remeasurements
* Ensure strong control discipline over:
* Data changes
* System updates

* Control compliance
* Close timelines

* Ownership
* Quality discipline
* Continuous improvement

* Improve:

**Job description**
-------------------


**About this role**

**About the Team**


At BlackRock, data isn't just a function — it's a strategic advantage. The Data Solutions and Reporting team sits at the heart of that advantage, supporting the global HR community and stakeholders across the firm with insights that span the entire employee lifecycle. We're not standing still — we're rapidly evolving from a Workday\-centric reporting team into a modern, AI\-integrated HR data platform, and we're looking for the right person to help us get there.

**The Opportunity**


This isn't your typical reporting role. We're looking for an Associate who is equal parts data engineer, Workday expert, and curious technologist who gets excited about connecting systems, automating the mundane, and building solutions that actually move the needle for HR and business leaders.


You'll partner with colleagues across HR, work closely with senior stakeholders, and have a real seat at the table in shaping how data and analytics are delivered at one of the world's leading investment management firms. And if you perform well? There's genuine room to grow.

**What You'll Do**


Build \& Own Core Reporting Solutions

* Design and deliver data solutions, reports, and dashboards that power decision\-making across HR functions — from HR Business Partners and Talent Management to DEI, Compensation, and Recruiting.
* Partner with HR leaders to ensure they always have accurate, timely, and meaningful access to data.
* Craft complex custom Workday reports (matrix, composite, advanced, and more) that go beyond the basics and truly serve the business.
* Collaborate with stakeholders through the full development lifecycle — from requirements to testing to post\-production adoption.
* Develop tactical and long\-term data models that are built to scale and flex as HR evolves.
* Own the end\-to\-end Workday release management process — evaluating new features, assessing impact, planning for changes, and driving implementation readiness every release cycle.
* Embed risk, controls, and data privacy best practices into every solution you build.


Connect the Ecosystem — Integrations \& Data Engineering

* Design, build, and maintain Workday integrations — both inbound (data into Workday) and outbound (data out of Workday) — using tools like Workday Studio, EIB, Core Connectors, and RaaS APIs.
* Be the central connector of our HR technology stack — someone who understands how data flows, where it lives, and how to make it work seamlessly across platforms.
* Partner with Technology \& Operations on integration testing, monitoring, and production support.


Shape Our Snowflake Future

* Play a key role in our migration of HR data from Workday to Snowflake, as we build toward a modern enterprise data platform.
* Build and maintain Snowflake data models and pipelines that give the business governed, scalable, self\-service access to HR data.
* Work alongside data engineering and platform teams to uphold data quality, access controls, and lifecycle governance.


Bring Data to Life with Power BI

* Build Power BI dashboards and reports that don't just display data — they tell a story and drive action at the senior leadership level.
* Use strong visualization and storytelling skills to translate complex workforce data into clear, compelling insights.
* Help lead the team's expansion into Power BI as a primary analytics and visualization platform alongside Workday Prism Analytics.


Explore What's Next *(Nice to Have)*

* Use Power Automate to eliminate repetitive workflows and bring efficiency to HR reporting processes.
* Experiment with and apply AI\-powered tooling — including building MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers or connecting Microsoft Copilot Studio to Workday to enable the next generation of conversational HR data experiences.
* Stay genuinely curious about where AI is taking HR technology — and bring those ideas back to the team.

**Who You'll Work With**


You'll build strong relationships across HR — Platforms \& Infrastructure, Operations, Business Partners, Talent, and Compensation — as well as across BlackRock's Corporate functions including Risk, Compliance, Finance, and Legal. You won't just be executing requests; you'll be a trusted partner helping the business become more data\-driven and self\-sufficient.

**What We're Looking For**

* 4\+ years of experience building and delivering impactful HR data, reporting, and dashboard solutions.
* Deep Workday expertise — advanced reporting, data modeling, and end\-to\-end knowledge of how Workday works under the hood.
* Workday Integrations experience — inbound and outbound — using EIB, Core Connectors, Workday Studio, or RaaS APIs.
* Snowflake proficiency — data modeling, SQL, and cloud data warehouse experience; HR data migration experience is a big plus.
* Power BI — ability to build production\-grade, executive\-ready dashboards and reports.
* Workday Prism Analytics experience strongly required.
* Sharp data visualization and storytelling skills that turn numbers into decisions.
* Meticulous attention to detail with a strong sense of data privacy and confidentiality.
* A problem\-solver who anticipates issues before they happen and drives solutions proactively.
* An active, proactive communicator — you don't wait to be asked, you set your own goals, track your progress, and keep stakeholders informed every step of the way.
* The ability to think end\-to\-end — from technical architecture to user experience — and deliver on both.

**The Kind of Person Who Will Thrive Here**


Beyond technical skills, we're looking for someone who brings energy, ownership, and curiosity to everything they do:

* Intellectually curious — you follow Workday releases, track AI developments, and are always thinking about what's next.
* A self\-starter — you own your work, set your own pace, and don't need to be told twice.
* Proactively communicative — you surface issues early, share updates often, and build trust naturally.
* A connector — you see the whole picture and love bringing systems, data, and people together.
* Growth\-minded — you're performing in this role today while already thinking about what you want to build tomorrow.

*We're at a pivotal moment — transforming from a traditional Workday reporting team into a modern, AI\-powered HR data platform. If you want to be part of building something meaningful and have the skills to make an impact from day one, we'd love to hear from you.*

**Our benefits**  

  

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

**Our hybrid work model**


BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

**About BlackRock**


At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.


This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

With thousands of hotels in over 100 countries and territories, Hilton offers countless opportunities to delight. In addition to our flagship brand, Hilton Hotels \& Resorts, the family of brands includes Waldorf Astoria, LXR, Conrad, Canopy, Curio Collection, DoubleTree, Hilton Garden Inn, Hampton and many others.

The Learning \& Development Manager coordinates and manages the implementation of hotel trainings in line with brand and hotel policies and procedures. He / she assists the Director of Human Resources in creating an effective and efficient operation for the Training department.

* Update the training notice board with all information on the situation in and out of the hotel as well as training information.
* Organize reward and certification programs.

* Regularly keep training records.
* Develop tools and systems to ensure training and development programs meet hotel objectives.
* Ensure that training and development are integrated into business plans and budgets, and targeted goals are identified and monitored.

* Prepare and manage the Training department’s budgets, monitor, analyze and report variations from the budget.
* Take part in team member performance reviews and set up development plans when required.
* Facilitate multiskilling.
* Manage the planning and delivery of orientation programs.
* Offer support and advice on personal development plans to team members under your supervision.
* Implement appropriate management practices that provide team members with motivation and communication.
* Provide information as required regarding training records and attendance.
* Assist all departmental trainers if necessary, with trainings.

* Be familiar with property safety, current first aid and fire emergency procedures.

* Carry out any other reasonable duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**What are we looking for?**

A Learning \& Development Manager, serving Hilton Brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:


* University graduate.
* Minimum 5 years of related working experience in the hotel industry.
* At least 3 years of management experience and relevant training experience.
* Excellent command of written and spoken English and Chinese to meet business needs.
* Solid knowledge of Learning \& Development.
* Good communication skills.
* Good presentation and teaching skills.
* Good project management skills.
* Excellent coordination and organization ability.
* Willing to take challenge and capability to work under high pressure.
* Strong capability in leadership.

**What will it be like to work for Hilton?**

Hilton is the leading global hospitality company, spanning the lodging sector from luxurious full\-service hotels and resorts to extended\-stay suites and mid\-priced hotels. For a century, Hilton has offered business and leisure travellers the finest in accommodations, service, amenities and value. Hilton is dedicated to continuing its tradition of providing exceptional guest experiences across its global brands. Our vision to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality unites us as a team to create remarkable hospitality experiences around the world every day. And, our amazing Team Members are at the heart of it all!

* Deploy optimum project delivery structure post transition/ migration phase by evaluating the budget, costs, risks and staffing requirement

* Ensure 100% compliance to Project SLAs, information security protocols and etc (all customers contractual obligations)

* Conduct periodic cadence with the quality team to take proactive measures to resolves issues/ possible escalations

* Regularly audit quality (QA) status of delivery and engage QA team to ensure adherence to Quality Assurance standards and processes
* Maintain project structure in Confluence \& SAP in line with prevailing business requirements and norms
* Ensure expected ramp down (ERD) compliance as committed in MSA
* Client Relationship Management
* Engage with client to deploy opportunities to deploy multiple solutions within/ across SLs to create a stronger value proposition for clients

\- Conduct regular customer connects (meetings/ visits/ video\- conference) and participate in Management Review Meetings (MRM) with client management/engagement managers to understand customers current and future needs and seek feedback to improve delivery methodology/ timelines/ resource allocation

* Plan and conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) along with DMs/ ADH with the client management/ leadership team to drive improvement actions and mine for a new portfolio/ opportunity within the account
* Design and monitor project performance dashboards/ reports with the clients periodically
* Delivery governance across the project
* Create weekly/ monthly/ quarterly MIS and reports to monitor and track overall project
* Conduct periodic reviews with the delivery team on operational, quality and fulfillment parameters and new idea generation \& its implementation on existing projects
* Identify and resolve potential risks or early warning signs on project delivery to drive for ZERO surprise escalations and eliminate any revenue leakage
* Escalate any deviations from the project charter to the delivery managers in terms of schedule, effort, cost, infrastructure from the project charter and minimize process exceptions and such deviations from the actual project plan

* Drive value adds and BVMs; ensure management showcases them to customer in MRM \& QBR to drive growth

**Documentation:** Maintain accurate records of all installations, repairs, and maintenance activities. Prepare reports and documentation for clients and management.

**Training:** Provide training and guidance to clients and end\-users on the proper operation and maintenance of fire alarm systems.

**Code Compliance:** Stay up\-to\-date with local and national fire safety codes and regulations to ensure all systems meet the required standards.

description:
**Business Development Associate \- Sales Executive**

**This is a sales role. Read that again.**

Not a coordination role. Not a marketing support role.

You will be responsible for building Kathputlee's client pipeline from the ground up — finding the right brands, getting them on a call, understanding what they need, and driving them toward a decision.

If you are looking for a role where someone hands you leads and a script, this is not it.

**If you are someone who cannot sleep when a deal is stuck — read on.**

**What Kathputlee does**

Kathputlee Arts \& Films is a brand content and production company. We make things brands use to grow — performance video ads, UGC creator content, brand films, and long\-format branded content.

We work with brands that need their content to do something — not just look good. Our work lives on Instagram, YouTube, Meta ad campaigns, and wherever the brand's audience is paying attention.

We are a small, senior team. We move fast. We do not have layers.

**What you will own**

* Identifying and reaching out to potential clients across brand categories — D2C, FMCG, startups, mid\-size companies looking to grow through content
* Running discovery conversations — understanding what a brand actually needs, not just what they say they need
* Qualifying leads and building a pipeline that the team can act on
* Cold Calling Leads , and handle initial queries , before a strategist or creative team
* Coordinating brief preparation when a client is ready to move
* Maintaining CRM discipline — every lead, every follow\-up, every update tracked
* LinkedIn outreach — building Kathputlee's presence in the right rooms
* As you grow: supporting pitch decks, attending client meetings, eventually closing independently

You will report directly to our Senior BD Lead. Our Founder will pull you into strategic assignments when the work calls for it.

**What we are looking for**

**Experience is not the filter. Instinct is.**

We will consider freshers. We will consider 0–5 year profiles. We will not consider people who need to be pushed to follow up.

**The signals we are looking for:**

* You have sold something in your life — formally or informally. A freelance project, a sponsorship, a deal of any kind. You know what it feels like to close.
* You are commercially curious. You watch brands, notice campaigns, wonder why things work — not because someone told you to.
* You are comfortable on calls with people who do not know you yet. You do not need a script to start a conversation.
* You understand — or are actively learning — what performance marketing, UGC content, and brand films mean and why brands spend on them.
* You are the kind of person who finds 10 ways to follow up before deciding a lead is dead.

Freshers are welcome — but only if you can show us sales DNA in the form. Not willing to learn. Actual instinct.

**What this is not**

* This is not a digital marketing execution role
* This is not a content creation role
* This is not a role where average performance is acceptable

**The incentive structure**

Fixed salary: ₹2,00,000 – ₹3,20,000 CTC per annum

Performance incentive: Unlocks after minimum KPI criteria are met. Percentage of deal value on every closed deal above threshold. Tiered — the better you close, the more you earn.

**The incentive is real. It is designed for someone who intends to close.**

**How to apply**

**Do not send a resume first.**

Fill out our application form. It takes 10–15 minutes. The questions will not feel like a standard job application — that is intentional.

We read every response. If your application moves forward, someone from our team will be in touch within 5–10 working days.

**→ Apply here: https://forms.gle/wQD97jSojET2Di7a9**

title: India Benefits & AI Operations Intern
description:
### **About the Team \& Role**


Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Our Global Benefits team is dedicated to ensuring Rubrikans are supported through every stage of their journey.


As our **India Benefits \& AI Operations Intern**, you will play a pivotal role in our own AI transformation. Reporting to the Manager of India Benefits, you will bridge the gap between human\-centric support and cutting\-edge technology. Your mission is to audit, structure, and modernize our benefits data so it can be seamlessly leveraged by AI tools, ensuring our employees get the right answers at the right time.


### **What You’ll Do**


* **Build the Foundation:** Develop a fully functioning, AI\-ready knowledge base for all India benefits (employee\-facing) to provide instant, clear support.
* **Market Benchmarking:** **Research and benchmark India benefit trends and competitive offerings to ensure Rubrik’s programs remain market\-leading, inclusive, and aligned with our EVP.**
* **Optimize Internal Ops:** Create internal\-facing documentation for India and APAC benefits processing to streamline workflows for the Global Benefits team.
* **AI Data Auditing:** Review and refine existing policy documents to ensure they are structured for high\-performance AI tools like NotebookLM or similar LLM platforms.
* **Enhance Jira Service Management:** Build out and refine knowledge articles within the Jira help desk to improve self\-service capabilities.
* **Process Automation:** Identify and propose opportunities to leverage AI to automate manual benefit administration tasks.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with HR Operations and IT to ensure benefits data is accessible, inclusive, and accurate across all internal platforms.


### **What You’ll Bring**


* **Academic Focus:** Currently pursuing a degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Data Science, or a related field.
* **Technical Curiosity:** High tech\-fluency with a deep interest in how Generative AI and automation can transform People Operations.
* **Communication Excellence:** Ability to translate complex benefit policies into simple, accessible, and inclusive language.
* **Analytical Mindset:** Strong attention to detail with the ability to audit large sets of information and conduct market research.
* **Problem\-Solving:** A proactive approach to identifying manual gaps and proposing digital\-first solutions.
* **Collaborative Spirit:** Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, global environment with a focus on team\-oriented outcomes.


### **Nice to Have**


* Familiarity with Jira Service Management or similar help desk ticketing systems.
* Basic understanding of India statutory benefits (EPF, ESI, Gratuity).
* Experience with data structuring or competitive research projects.


### **What You’ll Gain**


* **Impact:** You won't just be "learning"—you will be building the actual infrastructure Rubrik uses to support its employees.
* **Growth:** Direct mentorship from seasoned benefits leaders with over 15 years of experience in the India market.


**Empowerment:** The autonomy to experiment with AI tools and shape how we deliver benefits in the AI era.

**Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation**
----------------------------------------------------------------------


Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real\-time guardrails, fine\-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes.

  


**Inclusion @ Rubrik**
----------------------


At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.


Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential.


### **Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:**


* Our Company: We are committed to building a merit\-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here.
* Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries.
* Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities.

==================


Global Diageo Business Services (GDBS) is a global multi\-functional Enterprise Operations entity that supports different parts of Diageo businesses across the World.

====================

The purpose of this FP\&A role is to support delivery of the BPM reporting agenda for different regions.

* Strong verbal communication showing comfort in elaborating on ideas
* Support Market Finance Manager with data extraction and report consolidations
* Confidence, clarity of thoughts

* Help in the data extraction from various financial tools to support preparation and submission of Annual Operating Plan and Strategic Plan including supporting the OH planning, COGS Standard Reset process and overall consolidation.

* CA/CMA (Inter) /MBA (Tier 2 \& 3\) or equivalent desired.

* Good Business English, able to communicate effectively

* Basic analytical and planning skills.
* Good written and oral communication skills.
* Strong FP\&A background, good understand of financial foundations (P\&L and Cash flow)
* Strong and extensive Excel, Power Point and broad business knowledge. Superior PC modeling skills.

* **Training \& Documentation (India Focus):** Create user manuals, training materials, and other documentation specific to Indian payroll processes. Conduct end\-user training sessions for Indian payroll users.
* **Go\-Live \& Support (India Focus):** Support the go\-live process for Indian payroll implementations, including data migration and post\-implementation support. Provide ongoing support to end\-users in India, troubleshooting payroll issues and resolving problems.

**Key Skills \& Experience:**
* 8\+ years in SAP Payroll, with 3\+ years in **Employee Central Payroll (ECP)**.
* Strong knowledge of **Payroll Control Center (PCC)**, **BIB integrations**, and **EC–ECP data replication**.
* Experience with **payroll schemas, PCRs, off\-cycle payroll, and retro\-calculations**.
* Excellent understanding of **Time, Benefits, and Finance integration touchpoints**.
* SAP SuccessFactors ECP certification preferred.
* Strong client\-facing, leadership, and analytical skills.
* Bachelors or Masters in any field.

title: Client Finance Analyst
description:
Overview:
**Work Location –** Hyderabad /Gurugram

**Experience –** 3 to 5 Years

**Shift Timing –** 6:30pm \- 3:30am IST (During Day light Savings: 7:30 PM to 4:30 AM IST)


**Hybrid Mode –** 3 Days Work from Office per week

**Mandatory Skills:** FP\&A (Budgeting, Forecasting, Variance Analysis), Billing knowledge, Excel, Financial Reporting, Vantage / D365 ERP \- added advantage, Excellent communication skills

 **About Role :**


The Client Finance Analyst is the day\-to\-day contact for the financial and operational matters detailed below with supervision and guidance. The Client Finance Analyst interacts regularly with Account Management and Project Management teams as well as agencies' shared service center. The Client Finance Analyst is responsible for assigned clients in addition to ad hoc projects. The Client Finance Analyst must understand and comply with client contracts as they relate to compensation, billing, compliance, financial reporting, reconciliation, and other deliverables.

 **Join us at OGS**  

We are OGS—Omnicom's Integrated Solutions Engine that brings together a global talent community and connected capabilities in data, creative, media, commerce, and technology to build adaptive, future\-ready solutions.


We are redefining the global capability center \- not as an offshoring hub, but as a true inside edge. OGS is the place where the future is tested, built, and scaled for the world’s most ambitious agencies and clients.


With over 4300\+ talented professionals in India, we are proud to be a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative community that thrives on innovation and excellence. Our teams work with some of the world’s most iconic brands, helping them move faster and achieve more—everywhere. We are growing rapidly and looking for passionate individuals to be part of this journey.

  

At Omnicom Global Solutions India, work is more than a job—it is a space to grow, thrive, and feel celebrated. We foster a culture built on integrity, respect, equity, pride, and belonging, offering a holistic employee experience that empowers real impact.


Responsibilities:
* Manage, open and review requests for all billable and client non\-billable jobs opening, closing, and locking as appropriate
* Own the job status of each project and ensure that when Account Management and Project Management request a change in status that Omaha executes swiftly and reports are updated
* Communicate job numbers to team members so timesheets are accurate and timely
* Coordinate with agency teams including Account Management and Project Management, as well as Client Finance Managers so estimates are entered correctly and timely, as well as updated and approved in the system
* Coordinate monthly billings with shared service center to ensure billing is completed by the deadline of each assigned client
* Check invoice for accuracy including but not limited to amount, billing address, and contact information, as well as the integrity of client billing contract requirements
* Monitor and add commentary monthly on the WIP report
* Ensure that out\-of\-pocket expenses are being billed timely
* Prepare, update, and analyze trackers weekly so all estimates, actuals, variances, and billing information are pulled accurately
* Schedule meetings to review trackers according to cadence for each team
* Analyze and call out to Client Finance Manager and/or internal teams if projects are running hot and/or not tracking to benchmark
* Take diligent notes on job statuses and overall financial health of the projects for assigned clients during tracker meetings
* Send recap email to align on updates discussed in meeting and ensure any required updates are executed in advance of the next report run/review
* Perform administrative duties involving data entry such as rate card entry, opening jobs, closing jobs, overall job status of projects, running unapproved time reports, and estimate creation/status
* Assist with adhoc requests come up for assigned accounts and review with Client Finance Manager for submission to client and/or Account Management teams
* Collaborate with other Client Finance Analysts within the group to raise any issues or similar road bumps if any should occur
* Review all transfer requests for accuracy and ensure appropriate approvals are in place before transferring to Omaha Shared Services team
* Work with Accounts Receivable team to ensure timely client payments and align to payment terms within Master Service Agreemen

Qualifications:
* Bachelors or Post Graduate Degree in accounting or finance with 3\-5 years of experience in FP\&A Operations, Finance and Accounts
* Having prior experience into R2R processes is (Preferred)
* Proficient in Advanced Excel and ability to quickly learn any new ERP or BI Tools
* Having Good Knowledge of US GAAP.
* Flexibility to take up different assignments and not limit oneself to specific set of activities
* Ability to work both independently and in a team oriented, collaborative environment
* Flexible and Result Oriented with Strong Written \& Oral Communication Skills

**Desirable Skills \& Attributes**

* **MS Excel** \- Basic knowledge in functions and formulas to perform VLOOKUP, pivot tables, creating charts, graphs, cand overall data capture
* Basic knowledge of PowerPoint
* Knowledge of SAP and/or business systems a plus
* Knowledge of Vantage a plus

**Teamwork skills**

* Strong communication skills
* Organizational skills
* Goal\-oriented mindset
* Detail oriented
* Acute attention to detail, with an emphasis on consistency and continuity
* Attentiveness and shows interest in the subject\- Expresses ideas clearly and accurately
* Team\-oriented mindset

 **What Makes Life at OGS Special:**


Trust Through Transparency \& Integrity: We keep things open and fair with easy access to leaders and HR, ways to share your feedback, and clear processes that ensure honesty and accountability.


Culture of Support \& Care: We prioritize your well\-being through comprehensive benefits (Group Personal Accident Insurance, Health Insurance, Group Term Insurance), flexible leave options (Care4Me, Me Day, paternity leave, maternity leave, bereavement leave), structured onboarding, and resources for emotional and physical health.


We also offer complimentary meals, sports facilities like a TT table, subsidized CULT gym membership, and cab services at subsidized rates—because your comfort matters. Our people\-centric policies drive equity for all.


Recognition \& Growth: We empower your career through sponsored learning, leadership development programs, internal mobility opportunities, and meaningful recognition—celebrating impact while enabling continuous growth.


At OGS India, we are not just hiring for a role—we are inviting you to join a purpose\-driven, people\-first culture where your growth, well\-being, and individuality are celebrated every step of the way.

Responsibilities:

title: Senior Manager- Human Resources Business Partner
description:
At PwC, our people in talent and development focus on finding, deploying, training and enabling talent through talent identification and enhancing employee skills and knowledge, fostering a culture of continuous learning and professional growth. These individuals collaborate with subject matter specialists and project teams to strategize effective ways to locate, assess, educate and train employees, in line with market developments and firm strategy. As a talent generalist at PwC, you will focus on providing comprehensive talent support for leaders and guidance for employees, aligning talent strategies with business objectives. Your work will play a crucial role in improving employee retention, development and performance.
   

  

* Growing as a strategic advisor, you leverage your influence, expertise, and network to deliver quality results. You motivate and coach others, coming together to solve complex problems. As you increase in autonomy, you apply sound judgment, recognising when to take action and when to escalate. You are expected to solve through complexity, ask thoughtful questions, and clearly communicate how things fit together. Your ability to develop and sustain high performing, diverse, and inclusive teams, and your commitment to excellence, contributes to the success of our Firm.


**Skills**
 Examples of the skills, knowledge, and experiences you need to lead and deliver value at this level include but are not limited to:
   

  

* Craft and convey clear, impactful and engaging messages that tell a holistic story.
* Apply systems thinking to identify underlying problems and/or opportunities.
* Validate outcomes with clients, share alternative perspectives, and act on client feedback.
* Direct the team through complexity, demonstrating composure through ambiguous, challenging and uncertain situations.
* Deepen and evolve your expertise with a focus on staying relevant.
* Initiate open and honest coaching conversations at all levels.
* Make difficult decisions and take action to resolve issues hindering team effectiveness.
* Model and reinforce professional and technical standards (e.g. refer to specific PwC tax and audit guidance), the Firm's code of conduct, and independence requirements.


 The Opportunity
   

  

 When you join PwC Acceleration Centers (ACs), you step into a pivotal role focused on actively supporting various Acceleration Center services, from Advisory to Assurance, Tax and Business Services. In our innovative hubs, you’ll engage in challenging projects and provide distinctive services to support client engagements through enhanced quality and innovation. You’ll also participate in dynamic and digitally enabled training that is designed to grow your technical and professional skills.
   

  

 As part of the Talent and Development team you serve as a trusted advisor to partners/leaders with a focus on accelerating the development of people. As a Senior Manager you lead large projects, innovate processes, and maintain operational excellence while interacting with clients at a senior level to drive project success. You collaborate with partners/leaders to identify issues, develop and execute action plans across various areas of people strategy including diversity, development, performance management, and rewards and recognition.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead large projects and maintain operational excellence
* Innovate processes and drive project success
* Interact with clients at a senior level
* Serve as a trusted advisor to partners/leaders
* Accelerate the development of people
* Identify issues and develop action plans
* Focus on diversity, development, performance management, and rewards
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement


 What You Must Have
   

  

* High School Diploma
* 6 years of Human Capital or PwC Experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* Bachelor's Degree preferred
* PHR or SPHR preferred
* Serving as a trusted advisor to partners/leaders
* Collaborating with partners/leaders on people strategy
* Leading talent management and succession planning
* Developing meaningful relationships with staff
* Focusing on diversity initiatives
* Applying coaching skills to increase effectiveness
* Managing resource requirements and project workflow

The Digital HR Analyst supports the design, configuration, testing, and optimization of HR technology systems whether through hands on implementation or strong business partnering with Technology resources. This role focuses on system functionality, access governance, elevated troubleshooting, and continuous enhancement.


This role is ideal for someone with strong hands\-on HR technology experience, playing a larger role in system configuration of HR processes, can communicate strongly to ensure HR needs translate into sound system logic and influence design, enjoys working cross functionally and has strong project management skills.

**Key Responsibilities**.

**Driving Technology Advancement**

* **Appropriately solve** HR problems with sustainable technical solutions in line with HR strategy, proactively managing impacts across systems, people and process.
* **Configure and maintain HR systems according to requirements,** updating settings, foundational data, workflows and security roles with precision.
* Serve as a **key escalation point for complex system issues**, partnering with IT and vendors to troubleshoot and resolve root causes.
* Own the **full UAT lifecycle** for their enhancements, including test script development, tester coordination, and validation that system updates support accurate and efficient business processes. Documents results, mitigates risks before deployment, identifies change impacts requiring communication or training, and surfaces process gaps to guide future enhancements.
* **Identify opportunities for automation in HR** processes and helps design and test workflow logic.
* Support system releases to ensure smooth deployment of mandatory and optional changes; identifying and mitigating impacts, sharing recommendations, and assisting with change management efforts,

 **Access Management**

* **Configure role\-based access structures** approved via governance or partners with necessary resources to do so, defining permission logic in line with the role.

**User Enablement**

* **Keep clear and consistent technical documentation, job aids and user guides updated**, ensuring relevance and health of HR technology content.
* **Contributing content to, and answering questions from, Digital Training initiatives** to support HR staff in interacting with our technology.

**Cross Functional Collaboration**

* **Provide expert input on system capabilities, constraints, and configuration options** related to prioritized strategic initiatives.
* **Facilitate working sessions** to gather requirements, validate designs, and resolve issues where required.
* **Represent HR in digital or process improvement initiatives** as a subject matter contributor.

 **Qualifications**

**Required**

* 3\-5 years of hands\-on HR Technology or business analyst experience.
* Certification in one or more of our key HR platforms (Time and attendance platform (UKG Workforce Pro is Preferred) and ServiceNow, Phenom, SuccessFactors).

**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Matter.**


You are a specialist in a process, workstream or area in Mondelēz International Digital Services, working to support impeccable service operations.

* Ensure data accuracy in Workday and adherence to SLAs.
* Collaborate with recruiters, HR, and candidates for smooth onboarding.

**Key Skills:**

* Strong attention to detail and process orientation.
* Good communication and stakeholder management.
* Proficiency in Workday/ATS and Excel.

**Experience:**


1–3 years in HR operations / TA coordination (post\-offer to onboarding).


Within Country Relocation support available and for candidates voluntarily moving internationally some minimal support is offered through our Volunteer International Transfer Policy

title: HR Compliance Senior Associate
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**Overview**


The India HR Compliance Senior Associate is responsible for ensuring adherence to Indian employment laws, statutory requirements, and internal HR policies across our India operations. This role focuses on managing employment\-related compliance processes, supporting policy governance as well as the employee life cycle, and mitigating risk through proactive monitoring and advisory. The position partners with HR Compliance leadership, Talent Business Advisors, and key stakeholders to ensure compliant and consistent HR practices in alignment with central and state labor laws.


This position requires strong regulatory knowledge and critical thinking skills, analytical judgement, the highest level of confidentiality and discretion, and the ability to operate effectively and efficiently in a fast\-evolving compliance landscape.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Employment Law Compliance, Reporting \& Policy Governance**

* Support compliance with key Indian labor law requirements, including but not limited to:


	+ Gratuity Act
	+ Shops \& Establishments Act (state\-specific)
	+ POSH (Prevention of Sexual Harassment) Act
	+ Leave\-related statutory provisions
	+ Severance and separation\-related compliance
* Update and communicate HR policies, procedures, and applicable Indian labor laws (central and state\-specific) to employees, managers, and HR stakeholders.
* Support the review and maintenance of the India Employee Handbook to ensure alignment with evolving legal and regulatory requirements (e.g., Shops \& Establishments Acts, Industrial Employment regulations).
* Drive compliance program execution, including POSH awareness, training coordination, documentation, and audit readiness across office locations.
* Under the guidance of the India HR Compliance leader, provide support on policy interpretation in complex scenarios, ensuring alignment with statutory requirements and internal governance frameworks.
* Respond to employee and leadership queries related to HR policies, employment law, and compliance requirements.
* Identify compliance gaps and assist in drafting, updating, and implementing HR policies and procedures, and contribute to continuous improvement of compliance processes, controls, and systems.
* Ensure audit readiness for internal and external compliance reviews, audits, inspections, and compliance reporting, including maintaining accurate documentation and timely submissions.
* Assist in preparing employment\-related documentation such as employment verification letters, compliance certifications, and policy communications.
* Support compliance awareness initiatives (e.g., HR Connect sessions) to promote understanding of policies and legal obligations.

**Time Off (Leave) Compliance – EL / CL / SL**

* Manage compliance aspects of employee time\-off programs, including Earned Leave (EL), Casual Leave (CL), and Sick Leave (SL), ensuring alignment with applicable state laws and company policy.
* Support leave tracking and compliance with statutory accruals, carry\-forward, and encashment rules.
* Provide guidance to employees and managers on time\-off policies and ensure consistent application across the organization.
* Partner with HR systems teams to ensure accurate configuration and compliance of leave policies within HRIS platforms.

**Employee Relations \& HR Life Cycle Support**

* Escalate and support employee relations matters under the guidance of the HR Compliance Talent Relations leader, and in partnership with the Talent Business Advisor (TBA) team.
* Partner with the Talent Relations leader and Workplace Investigations team, as applicable, to ensure adherence to legal requirements and internal protocols regarding employee relations matters.
* Support governance of and ensure compliance with exit processes and employee separations, including adherence to applicable labor laws and statutory notice requirements, documentation standards, and internal processes.

**Qualifications and Requirements**

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Legal Studies, or related field.
* 4\-7\+ years of relevant experience in HR compliance, employee relations, or HR operations within India.
* Experience within professional services, consulting, or multinational organizations preferred.

**Specialized Knowledge**

* Strong working knowledge of Indian labor laws and statutory frameworks, including central and state\-specific regulations including Shops \& Establishments Acts.
* Experience supporting compliance programs such as POSH, gratuity, leave policies, and employee lifecycle compliance.
* Ability to interpret and apply legal and policy requirements in practical business scenarios.
* Demonstrated ability to manage sensitive investigations or escalations with discretion.
* Strong attention to detail with experience in audits, documentation, and compliance tracking.

**Core Competencies**

* **Judgement and Integrity:** Demonstrates strong ethical and sound decision\-making and uses the highest level of discretion and confidentiality in sensitive matters.
* **Analytical \& Problem\-Solving:** Ability to interpret complex regulations and resolve issues with minimal supervision.
* **Collaboration \& Communication:** Builds strong cross\-functional partnerships and communicates clearly, timely and effectively, both written and verbal.
* **Adaptability:** Operates effectively in dynamic, fast\-paced, evolving regulatory environments, and is comfortable with managing ambiguity and complexity while supporting change initiatives and shifting priorities.
* **Operational Excellence:** Exceptional organizational, time management, and project management skills with strong attention to detail and a focus on accuracy and compliance.
* **Technical Proficiency**: Proficiency in HRIS (e.g., Workday), compliance reporting tools, Microsoft Office, data reporting, and AI tools.

**Preferred/Additional Requirements**

* Professional certification in HR compliance, employment law, or related field (e.g., HRCI, SHRM, XLRI, CCEP, etc.).


We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  

At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!  

  

**How You Can Grow:**  

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!  

  

**More about Crowe:**


Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.


Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third\-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre\-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.


We are committed to a merit\-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job\-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

title: Team Lead - Recruitment
description:
**ROLE SUMMARY**

The Team Lead – Recruitment \& Operations is a high\-energy, execution\-focused role at Honest Hire. The primary responsibility is to lead a team of recruiters, drive daily hiring activity, and ensure monthly closure targets are consistently met. This person will also support HR operations deliverables for client accounts. We are not looking for someone who just manages — we need someone who rolls up their sleeves, pushes the team, and owns outcomes. If you are energetic, target\-driven, and have a solid grip on recruitment with some exposure to HR operations, this role is built for you.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Recruitment Management**

▪ Drive end\-to\-end recruitment for client mandates across industries including manufacturing, construction, IT, retail, and services.

▪ Ensure a minimum of 30 position closures per month across all client accounts.

▪ Source candidates through job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed), employee referrals, headhunting, and talent databases.

▪ Conduct first\-level screening, competency\-based shortlisting, and coordinate interview scheduling with clients.

▪ Maintain and optimize JD quality, sourcing pipelines, and ATS data hygiene across all open positions.

▪ Track weekly sourcing metrics, submission ratios, interview\-to\-offer rates, and closure timelines per recruiter.

**B. HR Operations**

▪ Oversee HR operations deliverables for Honest Hire's client accounts including onboarding, documentation, offer letters, appointment letters, and HR policy rollouts.

▪ Coordinate payroll inputs (attendance, variable pay, new joiners, exits) with the payroll team and ensure timely monthly processing.

▪ Ensure all statutory compliance TATs are met — PF, ESIC, PT, TDS — with zero delays or errors.

▪ Manage employee lifecycle documentation: contracts, confirmation letters, increment letters, exit paperwork, and Full \& Final settlements.

▪ Handle client\-side HR escalations with ownership and timely resolution.

**C. Team Management**

▪ Lead, mentor, and manage a team of 3–5 recruiters and HR executives with weekly target setting and performance reviews.

▪ Conduct daily standups to track pipeline status, bottlenecks, and closures.

▪ Provide structured coaching and feedback; identify skill gaps and ensure continuous learning.

description:
***Only freshers / students in last year should apply for this position.***

**Junior Valuer:**

As a junior plant and machinery valuer, your job profile would involve learning and assisting senior valuers in various aspects of the valuation process. Here's an overview of what your role might entail:

* **Assistance in Inspections**: You would assist senior valuers in conducting inspections of machinery and equipment. This involves learning how to assess the condition, functionality, and overall quality of the assets.
* **Data Collection**: Gathering relevant information and data about the machinery and equipment being valued. This could include specifications, maintenance records, usage history, and other pertinent details.
* **Market Research Support**: Assisting in market research activities to gather information on industry trends, pricing data, and comparable sales to help determine the market value of the assets.
* **Documentation and Record\-keeping**: Learning how to maintain accurate records and documentation of valuation activities, including inspection reports, data sheets, photographs, and other relevant documents.
* **Data Analysis**: Supporting senior valuers in analysing collected data and information to help determine the appropriate valuation methodologies and approaches to be used.
* **Report Preparation**: Assisting in the preparation of valuation reports under the guidance of senior valuers. This may involve compiling data, drafting sections of the report, and ensuring that all necessary information is included.
* **Client Interaction**: Learning how to effectively communicate with clients to understand their valuation needs, gather additional information, and provide updates on the valuation process.
* **Continued Learning**: Actively engaging in ongoing training and professional development activities to expand your knowledge of valuation methodologies, industry standards, and relevant regulations.
* **Quality Assurance**: Participating in quality assurance processes to ensure that valuation reports meet the required standards of accuracy, completeness, and compliance.
* **Team Collaboration**: Collaborating with other team members, including senior valuers, engineers, and administrative staff, to ensure smooth coordination and execution of valuation projects.

Overall, as a junior plant and machinery valuer, your role would involve learning the ropes of the valuation process, gaining hands\-on experience under the guidance of experienced professionals, and gradually taking on more responsibilities as you develop your skills and expertise in the field.

**Job Title: VP – Customer Success**

**Location:** Bengaluru / India (with travel as required)  
**Organization:** Janitri Innovations Pvt. Ltd.  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time

**About Janitri**

Janitri is a fast\-growing health\-tech company dedicated to improving maternal and newborn outcomes through innovative medical devices and digital health solutions. Our products are deployed across hospitals and healthcare systems, impacting thousands of pregnancies and births.

Over the years, Janitri has built a strong presence across **public and private healthcare ecosystems**, working closely with clinicians, hospitals, and government programs. With multiple recognitions and a growing footprint, we are now entering a **high\-growth phase focused on scale, adoption, and deeper impact**.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a **VP – Customer Success** who can build and scale a **technology\-driven customer success function** that ensures strong adoption, retention, and impact across both enterprise healthcare customers and end users.

This role requires someone who understands that customer success is not just relationship management — it is about **building systems, leveraging technology, and driving outcomes at scale**.

You will work closely with product, clinical, sales, and operations teams to ensure our solutions are effectively adopted and deliver measurable value across both **B2B (hospitals, doctors)** and **B2C (end users / patients)** segments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the **end\-to\-end customer lifecycle** — onboarding, implementation, adoption, engagement, retention, and expansion.
* Build and scale a **tech\-enabled customer success function**, including CRM systems, automation, dashboards, and customer health tracking.
* Drive **product adoption and utilization** across hospitals, clinicians, and end users.
* Design scalable onboarding, training, and engagement journeys for both enterprise customers and consumer users.
* Ensure high **customer retention, satisfaction, and lifetime value** across segments.
* Build and lead a high\-performing **Customer Success team**, including field teams, onboarding specialists, and account managers.
* Develop structured **customer feedback loops** and work closely with product and engineering teams to improve offerings.
* Monitor and optimize key metrics such as **NPS, retention, activation, engagement, and usage**.
* Identify risks proactively and ensure resolution to maintain strong customer relationships.
* Collaborate with sales and business teams to drive **upsell and cross\-sell opportunities**.
* Build deep relationships with hospital leadership, doctors, partners, and ecosystem stakeholders.
* Drive customer success strategies across both **public health programs and private healthcare institutions**.

**Who We’re Looking For**

* A leader who has **built or scaled customer success using technology and systems**, not just manual processes.
* Experience managing both **enterprise (B2B)** and **consumer (B2C)** customer success journeys.
* Strong understanding of **customer lifecycle, engagement, retention, and product adoption at scale**.
* Experience in **high\-growth environments**, building processes from scratch.
* Ability to balance **strategy with execution** in a fast\-paced setup.
* Strong stakeholder management across internal teams and external customers.
* High ownership mindset with a focus on outcomes and impact.
