title: Network Engineer
description:
**About Us**
 At
 **Providence Global Center Hyderabad** 
 , we build and operate highly reliable, secure, and scalable enterprise network platforms that support mission‑critical applications across on‑premises and hybrid cloud environments. Our Network Engineering team focuses on automation, visibility, and operational excellence by leveraging industry‑leading tools such as SolarWinds, Cisco ISE, Infoblox DDI, and Azure networking services. As part of our ongoing transformation, we are expanding our capabilities in Infrastructure as Code, analytics, and data‑driven operations to improve reliability, compliance, and efficiency across the organization.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 As a
 **Network Engineer II** 
 , you will design, support, and maintain enterprise LAN environments, including switching, VLANs and redundancy, to ensure stable and secure network connectivity.
   

  

 You will work closely with the Network Operations team to
 **monitor, troubleshoot and resolve LAN incidents** 
 , and you will participate in an
 **On\-Call rotation** 
 to provide timely support for network outages and critical issues outside business hours.
   

  

 You will track DPMO (Defects Per Million Opportunities) to reduce repeat LAN problems and improve overall network reliability.
   

  

 You will also support LGW (LAN Get Well) activities by assisting in the replacement of End‑of‑Life (EOL) network devices, helping keep the LAN environment stable, secure and up to date.
   

  

 This role requires strong troubleshooting skills, hands‑on experience with enterprise switches, Multicast, routing protocol and the ability to work effectively in a team‑based environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Support day‑to‑day LAN network operations across campus, clinic and hospital environments.
* Participate in On\-Call rotation to troubleshoot and restore LAN outages and critical incidents.
* Monitor LAN health using operational dashboards and alerts, act on configuration compliance gaps.
* Responsible for access‑layer stability, with strong knowledge of STP/RSTP/MST, root‑bridge design, and rapid resolution of loop and convergence issues in campus LANs
* Troubleshoot Layer‑2 and Layer‑3 LAN issues including VLANs, trunking, STP, port‑channels, and access connectivity.
* Drive DPMO improvements by identifying recurring issues and reducing repeat network defects.
* Execute LGW (LAN Get Well) activities focused on EOL device replacement across access, distribution and core layers.
* Perform IOS upgrades, hardware refreshes, and switch lifecycle activities aligned with standards.
* Plan and execute maintenance window changes, including cutovers, migrations, and post‑change validation.
* Create and follow MOPs, perform port mapping, and coordinate with field/CTS/EUS teams during site work.
* Ensure configuration standardization and compliance across LAN devices.
* Support incident management, RCA and problem management with clear documentation and communication.
* Collaborate with LAN Engineering, Wireless, Security and Service Desk teams to maintain stable and reliable LAN services.
* Use SolarWinds to monitor switch availability, performance, alerts, and inventory; ensure LAN devices are properly onboarded and monitored.
* Support network segmentation initiatives, including VLAN‑based segmentation and coordination with Cisco ISE enforcement for access control and policy compliance.
* Implement and maintain DCFC LAN standards, ensuring switch configurations, design, and segmentation align with approved enterprise and clinical network guidelines.
* Identify and automate repetitive LAN operational tasks using Python, Ansible, or similar scripting tools to improve efficiency, consistency, and reliability across campus access‑layer environments.


**What would your day look like?**
* Start the day by reviewing LAN health and alerts in SolarWinds, ensuring switches across campuses, clinics, and hospitals are online and compliant.
* Respond to incidents and service requests, troubleshooting Layer‑2 and Layer‑3 LAN issues such as VLANs, trunking, STP, and access connectivity.
* Own access‑layer health, proactively managing STP/RSTP/MST and responding quickly to any campus LAN loop or convergence events.
* Work with Wireless and Security teams to resolve connectivity and network segmentation issues, including VLAN placement and Cisco ISE enforcement.
* Perform proactive operational work, analysing recurring issues and contributing to DPMO reduction to improve network reliability.
* Execute planned maintenance activities, including IOS upgrades, hardware refreshes, and LGW (LAN Get Well) EOL device replacements.
* Prepare and follow MOPs, coordinate with CTS/EUS field teams, perform cutovers, and validate network stability after changes.
* Ensure LAN configuration standardization and DCFC standards are followed across the environment.
* Participate in On\-Call support as needed, restoring service during after‑hours outages and handing off updates clearly to the team.
* Develop automation scripts (Python/Ansible) to eliminate repetitive LAN operational tasks and improve run‑time efficiency.


**Who are we looking for?**
* Bachelor’s or equivalent in Engineering/Technology.
* 3–5 years total experience in enterprise networking/operations, with:
+ 3\+ years hands\-on experience on LAN protocols.
+ 3\+ years with EOL device replacements
+ 2\+ years with Cisco ISE, multicast and routing protocols.

* Engineer who has good Knowledge of L2/L3 networking: VLANs, STP/MST, LACP/Port‑Channel, OSPF/BGP, HSRP/VRRP, QoS, ACLs/NAT.
* hands‑on LAN engineer who owns day‑to‑day campus access‑layer stability across campuses, clinics, and hospitals.
* An engineer comfortable responding to incidents and service requests, troubleshooting Layer 2 and Layer 3 LAN issues including VLANs, trunking, STP, and access connectivity
* A strong owner of the access layer, proactively managing STP/RSTP/MST and responding quickly to loop or convergence events to minimize user impact.
* A proactive Engineer who analyses recurring issues, contributes to DPMO reduction and continuously improves LAN reliability.
* An engineer experienced in planned maintenance and lifecycle activities, including IOS upgrades, hardware refreshes, and EOL (LGW) device replacements.
* A disciplined Engineer who ensures LAN configuration standardization and DCFC standards are consistently followed.
* A team member willing to participate in On\-Call support, restore service during after‑hours outages, and provide clear handoffs and documentation.
* An engineer who identifies and automates repetitive LAN operational tasks using Python, Ansible or similar scripting tools to improve efficiency, consistency, and reduce manual errors.

title: MS Engineer - Network
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

**Your day at NTT DATA**
 As a Networking Managed Services Engineer (L1\) at NTT DATA, you'll step into an entry\-level role where your primary focus will be providing managed services to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. Your day will involve proactively identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems to support our clients effectively.
   

  

 You'll monitor client infrastructure and solutions, catching errors before or as soon as they occur. Your role will involve investigating first\-line incidents, understanding their root causes, and following approved procedures for request fulfilment. Whether it's providing telephonic, ITSM ticket or chat support, executing maintenance activities like patching and configuration changes, or ensuring smooth shift handovers for continuous service, your efforts are all about maintaining high standards of service quality.
   

  

 You'll also identify opportunities for optimization, whether it's reducing common incidents or finding automation possibilities for request fulfilment, incident resolution, and process improvements. Your role may occasionally extend to supporting project work and disaster recovery functions and tests, contributing to our broader goals and ensuring we're always ahead of the curve.
   

  

 Throughout your journey with us, you'll ensure that incidents and requests are resolved efficiently and comprehensively, escalating when necessary. You'll also help update existing knowledge or to share valuable insights, ensuring we continuously learn and improve.
   

  

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**
* Basic understanding in technologies such as Pulse Secure SSL VPN, Virtual Juniper, Palo Alto, Fortinet Firewalls, Cisco Nexus switches, ASr and ISr routers, Cisco ACS, ISE, Meraki switches, and common routing protocols like BGP, OSPF, and EIGrP.

* Good understanding of using ITSM tools and ITSM processes.
* Strong planning skills, considering possible changes and circumstances.
* A strong work ethic, including the capacity to put in longer hours when necessary.
* Adaptability to changing environments.
* A client\-focused approach, creating positive client experiences throughout their journey.
* The aptitude to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups.

title: civil site engineer
description:
Job Description: Civil Site EngineerPosition Details

* **Job Title:** Civil Site Engineer
* **Department:** Projects / Construction
* **Reports To:** Project Manager / Senior Site Engineer
* **Location:** Site Office
* **Employment Type:** Full\-Time

Job Summary

The Civil Site Engineer is responsible for supervising and monitoring day\-to\-day construction activities at the project site, ensuring that work is completed according to approved drawings, specifications, quality standards, and project timelines. The role involves coordination with contractors, vendors, architects, consultants, and internal teams to ensure smooth execution of civil works.

Key ResponsibilitiesSite Supervision

* Supervise all civil construction activities at the site.
* Ensure execution of work as per approved drawings, specifications, and project schedule.
* Monitor daily site progress and prepare progress reports.
* Coordinate with contractors, subcontractors, and labor teams.
* Ensure availability of materials, machinery, and manpower at site.

Planning \& Coordination

* Review project drawings and technical specifications before execution.
* Coordinate with architects, structural consultants, MEP teams, and project managers.
* Prepare work schedules and monitor project timelines.
* Resolve site issues and provide technical guidance to workers and contractors.

Quality Control

* Check quality of materials received at site.
* Ensure work is carried out in accordance with quality and safety standards.
* Conduct inspections and maintain quality checklists.
* Identify defects and ensure corrective action is taken.

Measurement \& Billing

* Take site measurements and maintain measurement records.
* Verify contractor bills and quantities executed.
* Prepare bar bending schedules, material reconciliation, and work completion reports.
* Maintain records for daily progress, labor attendance, and material consumption.

Safety Compliance

* Ensure compliance with safety procedures and use of PPE.
* Report unsafe conditions and accidents immediately.
* Conduct regular safety checks at site.

Documentation

* Maintain all site\-related documents, drawings, permits, and reports.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports.
* Maintain site registers and records for audit and compliance purposes.

Required Qualifications

* Diploma / Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering.
* 2–5 years of experience in civil construction or site execution.
* Freshers may be considered for junior roles.

Required Skills

* Knowledge of construction methods, materials, and site practices.
* Ability to read and interpret drawings and BOQs.
* Knowledge of AutoCAD, MS Excel, and MS Project.
* Strong communication and coordination skills.
* Good problem\-solving and time\-management ability.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

Preferred Experience

* Experience in residential, commercial, industrial, or infrastructure projects.
* Familiarity with local building regulations and safety requirements.
* Experience in contractor handling and site management.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely completion of assigned work.
* Quality compliance and minimum rework.
* Adherence to project timelines and budget.
* Proper maintenance of site records and reports.
* Compliance with safety standards.

Working Conditions

* Work is primarily based at the project site.
* May require extended hours, weekend work, or travel depending on project requirements.
* Use of safety gear and site PPE is mandatory.

Compensation \& Benefits

* Salary as per company policy and experience.
* Site allowance / travel allowance, if applicable.
* Statutory benefits such as PF, ESI, leave, and gratuity as applicable.

title: Data Engineering And Analytics - Business Analyst
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Business Analyst – Data, Analytics and AI**
**The Opportunity**
 As a Business Analyst (Data, Analytics and AI) at EY, you will play a pivotal role in shaping, governing, and delivering data‑driven and AI‑enabled solutions for Clients \& Industries (C\&I) and select EY‑wide initiatives. You will be part of the Data Strategy team, operating at the intersection of business, analytics, and AI to ensure that Analytics and Copilot‑led agentic solutions are aligned to strategic objectives and deliver measurable business value.
   

  

 This role combines hands‑on delivery with ownership of analytics and AI governance, operating models, and value realization. You will act as the Business Analyst on Data Analytics and AI initiatives, while also contributing to data strategy, metric standardization, and trusted data foundations across C\&I.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Business Analysis \& Stakeholder Leadership**
* Lead discovery and requirements definition for data, analytics, and AI initiatives across Clients \& Industries.
* Partner with senior stakeholders to shape business problems into clear analytics and AI use cases with defined success measures.
* Translate business needs into structured requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria aligned to delivery backlogs.
* Act as a trusted advisor, balancing strategic objectives with execution‑focused delivery.


**Data Strategy, Governance \& Operating Model**
* Contribute to C\&I data strategy by identifying priority data domains, decision journeys, and analytics opportunities.
* Define and govern enterprise KPIs, metrics, and reporting standards to ensure consistency and trust.
* Maintain business glossaries, metric definitions, and analytics standards aligned with data governance practices.


**Data Collection, Data Quality \& Trusted Data**
* Define data collection requirements including sources, granularity, frequency, ownership, and quality expectations.
* Identify data gaps, quality issues, and remediation needs. Establish validation rules and “trusted data” criteria for analytics and AI use cases.
* Ensure compliance with EY data security, privacy, and regulatory standards, including GDPR.


**Analytics Delivery, Insights \& Value Realization**
* Partner with analytics teams to deliver actionable insights and executive‑ready narratives.
* Validate dashboards, reports, and AI outputs for accuracy, relevance, and business alignment.
* Drive adoption through enablement, walkthroughs, and targeted stakeholder communication.
* Identify optimization opportunities to enhance analytics and AI impact.
* Provide functional guidance to junior Data Engineers and ensure clarity of requirements and priorities.
* Collaborate across global, multi‑disciplinary C\&I teams to deliver outcomes.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* AI‑first mindset with strong interest in Copilot‑led solutions and intelligent automation.
* Strong Business Analysis capability in data‑ and analytics‑heavy environments.
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands‑on delivery and execution rigor.
* Executive presence and confidence engaging senior stakeholders as a trusted partner.
* Strong relationship‑building and influencing skills across business and technology teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to simplify complexity.
* Strong judgment, structured thinking, and operational discipline in a fast‑paced environment.
* Ability to operate effectively across geographies, cultures, and service lines.


**Technical Expertise**
* Strong working knowledge of data and analytics concepts (KPIs, data models, data quality, data lineage).
* Proficiency in SQL for data validation and analysis; familiarity with Python is advantageous.
* Experience with Power BI (preferred) or similar visualization tools (Tableau, Spotfire).
* Familiarity with Microsoft Azure analytics services (e.g., Data Factory, Synapse, Data Lake) from a requirements and design perspective.
* Experience with Copilot Studio for defining and validating AI agent solutions.
* Familiarity with Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate) integration patterns.
* Exposure to Alteryx preferred but not mandatory.


**What We Look For**
 We are looking for Manager‑level professionals who can combine data strategy, analytics delivery, and AI enablement to drive tangible business outcomes for Clients \& Industries. You should be a structured problem solver, a strong communicator, and a collaborative leader who can operate comfortably across strategy, governance, and execution.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

No matter whether people “Print for Earning” (Big Presses printing \- Magazines, News Papers, Banners, Packages, etc.) or they “Print because they Earn” (Office \& Home printers), they most probably use our print technology. Work involves deep domain (PDF, PostScript etc.), but it also spreads across multiple platforms and operating systems. * You would be required to address broad architecture and design issues of future products or technologies and provide strategic direction in evaluating new technologies in their area of expertise

* Strong C/C\+\+ coding background
* Proficiency in data structures and algorithms

 Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

 Docusign is looking for a highly motivated full stack Software Engineer to join our commerce platform team. This person will work in a close knitted development Pod of 4\-6 engineers to develop, test, and support features and experimentation on ecom.docusign.com and adjacent experiences. The Commerce engineering team offers unique learning opportunities where you will be directly involved in end\-to\-end customer experience ownership across a large surface area of product and engineering collaboration. We look for candidates with love for computer science and engineering, and we truly believe you will enjoy and find success in this team.
   

  

 This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Engineering Manager, Commerce Platform.
   

  

**Responsibility**
* Design and develop high\-quality, user\-focused experiences \- we currently use C\#/React/Node.js
* Build, maintain, and scale a robust UI and micro\-services
* Write clean, maintainable, and well\-documented code following industry best practices
* Develop and maintain comprehensive automated tests, including unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing, to ensure reliability and stability
* Work within an Agile development environment, leveraging best practices like CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and effective code reviews
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with designers, product managers, and backend engineers to create seamless user\-facing applications
* Mentor and support other engineers within the organization, providing technical guidance and knowledge sharing
* Present software architecture and technical strategies to executives, influencing key decision\-making
* Work as part of a cross\-site development team to drive the design, implementation, testing, and release of products
* Proactively identify and address potential technical risks, performance bottlenecks, and usability issues before they impact product delivery
* Stay up\-to\-date with emerging technologies and industry trends to continuously improve the frontend ecosystem


 Job Designation
   

  

**Hybrid:** 
 Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation)
   

  

 Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.
   

  

 What you bring

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Systems, Informatics, or equivalent experience
* 2\+ years of professional experience in the backend and frontend development, specializing in the C\#/React/Node.js ecosystem and user\-facing applications
* Proven track record of developing and shipping highly scalable, consumer\-facing web applications
* Experience working in Agile environments, utilizing best practices for version control (Git), CI/CD workflows, and automated testing


**Preferred**
* Experience with Next.js for server\-side rendering (SSR) and static site generation (SSG).

description:
An extraordinarily talented group of individuals work together every day to drive TNS' success, from both professional and personal perspectives. Come join the excellence!
   

  

**Overview**
 We are looking for a Network Engineer who will be responsible for maintaining and administering our company's computer networks. Your primary duties will include maintenance of computer networks, hardware, software, and other related systems, performing disaster recovery operations, protecting data, software, and hardware from attacks, and replacing FRulty network hardware components when necessary. You will also be working closely with the users of our network in order to identify potential issues and fix existing problems. To be a successful candidate, you will need to have a strong understanding of network infrastructure and network hardware. You will also need to be able to implement, administer, and troubleshoot network devices including WAPs, firewalls, routers, switches, and controllers. A deep knowledge of application transport and network infrastructure protocols is highly desired.

* Performing disaster recovery operations and data backups when required.
* Protecting data, software, and hardware by coordinating, planning and implementing network security measures.
* Troubleshooting, diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, and other network and system problems.
* Replacing FRulty network hardware components when required.
* Maintaining, configuring, and monitoring virus protection software and email applications.
* Monitoring network performance to determine if adjustments need to be made.
* Conferring with network users about solving existing system problems.
* Operating master consoles to monitor the performance of networks and computer systems.
* Coordinating computer network access and use.
* Designing, configuring and testing networking software, computer hardware, and operating system software.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor degree in Information Technology related field of study with a network engineering focus.
* Strong understanding of network infrastructure and network hardware.
* Ability to think through problems and visualize solutions.
* Ability to implement, administer, and troubleshoot network infrastructure devices, including wireless access points, firewall, routers, switches, controllers.
* Knowledge of application transport and network infrastructure protocols.
* Ability to create accurate network diagrams and documentation for design and planning network communication systems.
* Provides specific detailed information for hardware and software selection.
* Ability to quickly learn new or unFRmiliar technology and products using documentation and internet resources.
* Ability to work with all levels of staff within and outside of IT and outside the organization.
* A self\-starter able to work independently but comfortable working in a team environment.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Dependable and flexible when necessary.
* Network security experience.
* LAN and WAN experience.
* 1\-2 years experience

Our platforms include CMS\-driven websites, event microsites, award platforms, and content\-based portals. We are focused on building high\-performance, SEO\-driven digital assets that generate traffic, engagement, and revenue.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a **detail\-oriented and execution\-focused Web Developer with strong SEO expertise** to manage, enhance, and optimize our WordPress\-based websites and digital ecosystem.

This role goes beyond development — it combines **technical execution with SEO performance ownership**, ensuring websites are fast, discoverable, and conversion\-focused.

If you take ownership, think in terms of growth, and don’t wait for instructions — this role is for you.

**Key Responsibilities1\. Website Development \& Management**

* Develop, maintain, and scale WordPress websites
* Customize themes and plugins using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, PHP, and MySQL
* Ensure mobile responsiveness and cross\-browser compatibility
* Improve page speed and Core Web Vitals
* Implement SEO\-friendly website architecture and clean code practices

**2\. Technical SEO \& Performance Optimization**

* Perform **technical SEO audits** and implement fixes
* Optimize on\-page elements: meta tags, schema markup, headings, internal linking
* Improve crawlability, indexing, and site structure (sitemaps, robots.txt)
* Monitor and enhance Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP)
* Use tools like **Google Search Console, Google Analytics, SEMrush/Ahrefs** for tracking and optimization
* Identify keyword opportunities and collaborate on content optimization
* Fix SEO issues such as broken links, duplicate content, redirects, and indexing errors

**3\. Hosting \& Server Management**

* Manage hosting environments (cPanel, VPS, cloud hosting)
* Troubleshoot server errors, downtime, and database issues
* Maintain backups, staging environments, and security protocols

**4\. Payment \& Integrations**

* Integrate and manage payment gateways (Razorpay, PayPal)
* Maintain event registration systems and transactional workflows

**5\. Digital Operations**

* Manage newsletters using Mailchimp and Brevo
* Publish podcasts via RSS editors to platforms like Spotify
* Coordinate with vendors for API integrations and updates
* Manage Google Workspace accounts and email configurations

**6\. Design \& Media Support**

* Create and optimize website visuals using Canva or Adobe Photoshop
* Design and manage digital flipbooks using Flip PDF Professional

**7\. IT \& Admin Coordination**

* Maintain IT asset records and digital infrastructure documentation
* Support basic internal IT troubleshooting
* Coordinate vendor billing and digital service invoices

**Required Skills**

* Strong proficiency in WordPress (theme customization, plugin handling)
* HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL
* Strong understanding of **Technical SEO and on\-page SEO**
* Experience with SEO tools (Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush/Ahrefs)
* Knowledge of Core Web Vitals and performance optimization
* Hosting and server troubleshooting knowledge
* Payment gateway integration experience
* Understanding of UI/UX and responsive design principles
* Familiarity with Mailchimp/Brevo mass mailing systems
* Basic understanding of RSS feeds and podcast publishing
* Working knowledge of Canva or Photoshop
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science / IT / Engineering
* 1–3 years of hands\-on experience in **Web Development \+ SEO**
* Freshers with strong live website portfolio and SEO project exposure may apply
* Experience in media, publishing, or event\-based websites is a plus

**Growth Opportunity**

* Exposure to international B2B media platforms
* Opportunity to work on **high\-traffic SEO\-driven websites**
* Scope to grow into **Digital Marketing Lead / Technical SEO Specialist**

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates may share their updated CV at **hr@aerospacemediagroup.com**

dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, partnering with the world’s most ambitious retailers and brands to put the customer at the heart of every decision. We combine deep insight, advanced technology, and close collaboration to help our clients grow, innovate, and deliver measurable value for their customers.
   

  

 dunnhumby employs nearly 2,500 experts in offices throughout Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Americas working for transformative, iconic brands such as Tesco, Coca\-Cola, Nestlé, Unilever and Metro.
   

  

**We’re looking for a Full Stack Engineer who expects more from their career.** 
 This role offers an opportunity to build scalable, high\-performance solutions in the engineering team, enhance code quality and engineering excellence, and contribute to critical architecture decisions within a data driven environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in Full Stack development, focusing on performance, scalability, security, and maintainability.
* Strong proficiency in Frontend tech like React.js/Angular and Javascript.
* Strong proficiency in backend programming language, system design, Oops concepts.
* Drive code quality, ensuring adherence to best practices, design patterns, and SOLID principles.
* Experience with cloud platforms (Google Cloud Platform \& Azure), implementing cloud native best practices for scalability, security, and resilience.

* Knowledge in CI/CD automation, with experience in GitOps workflows and Infrastructure\-as Code (Terraform, Helm, or similar).


**What you can expect from us**
 We won’t just meet your expectations. We’ll defy them. So you’ll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you’d expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.
   

  

 You’ll also benefit from an investment in cutting\-edge technology that reflects our global ambition. But with a nimble, small\-business feel that gives you the freedom to play, experiment and learn.
   

  

 And we don’t just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day – with thriving networks including dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One, dh Enabled and dh Thrive as the living proof. We want everyone to have the opportunity to shine and perform at your best throughout our recruitment process. Please let us know how we can make this process work best for you.
   

  

**Our approach to Flexible Working**
 At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.
   

  

 We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process.
   

  

 For further information about how we collect and use your personal information please see our Privacy Notice which can be found

title: Frontend Developer (Freelancer)
description:
**About Us:** 




 Deccan AI experts is a pioneering company founded by IIT Bombay and IIM Ahmedabad alumni, with a strong founding team from IITs, NITs, and BITS. We specialize in
 **delivering high\-quality human\-curated data, AI\-first scaled operations services, and more** 
 . Based in SF and Hyderabad, we are a young, fast\-moving team on a mission to build AI for Good, driving innovation and positive societal impact.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 We are looking for a
 **Frontend Developer** 
 to join us for critical projects. You will be working with big techs in the AI industry to help them build accurate responses from cutting\-edge AI foundational models aimed at delivering exceptional user interface and user experience capabilities
 



 In this role, you will be part of a highly skilled team with niche domain expertise, playing a pivotal role in improving the accuracy, usability, and performance of SOTA (state\-of\-the\-art) models in frontend development workflows.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Annotate model responses and develop feedback to improve the technical accuracy, design clarity, and overall quality of large language model (LLM) outputs related to frontend systems.
* Review frontend\-related queries to assist in training AI models.
* Evaluate the quality, correctness, and performance of code generated by AI in frontend languages, frameworks, and libraries.
* Analyze and rate AI\-generated responses for UI/UX design principles, responsiveness, accessibility, performance, and best practices.
* Identify common failure points or inaccuracies in AI\-generated frontend solutions and suggest targeted improvements to enhance future outputs.



  





**Requirements:** 



* Proficiency in frontend technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frameworks like React, Vue, or Angular.
* Enthusiasm to contribute to the performance and reliability of foundational AI models.
* Experience with responsive design, component\-based architecture, and cross\-browser compatibility.
* Familiarity with frontend build tools, state management, and testing frameworks (e.g., Webpack, Redux, Jest).



  





**Why join us?** 



* Competitive hourly pay: upto ₹1500 per hour.
* Fully remote and flexible work schedule.
* Opportunity to contribute to the advancement of AI technology.



  





 NOTE: Pay will vary by project and typically is up to ₹1500 per hour. If you work an average of 3 hours every day, you could earn up to ₹90,000 per month once you clear our screening process.

We are looking for a passionate and driven **Front End Developer Intern** who has a strong interest in AI tools and modern development practices. * Ability to write effective prompts for generating, debugging, and refactoring code.

description:
**Job Title:** HR Recruiter  
**Experience: 1\-** **2** Years

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a motivated **HR Recruiter with 2 years of experience** to manage the end\-to\-end recruitment process. The ideal candidate will be responsible for sourcing, screening, and coordinating with candidates and hiring managers to fill open positions efficiently.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Handle **end\-to\-end recruitment** for technical and non\-technical roles.
* Source candidates through **job portals, LinkedIn, referrals, and social media**.
* Screen resumes and conduct **initial HR interviews** to assess candidate suitability.
* Schedule and coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers.
* Maintain and update the **candidate database and recruitment tracker**.
* Communicate with candidates regarding **interview updates, feedback, and offer discussions**.
* Assist in **offer rollout and onboarding coordination**.
* Ensure a **positive candidate experience** throughout the hiring process.
* Work closely with hiring managers to understand **job requirements and hiring timelines**.

**Required Skills**

* Strong experience in **sourcing and screening candidates**.
* Hands\-on experience with **LinkedIn, Naukri, and other job portals**.
* Good understanding of **recruitment lifecycle**.
* Strong **communication and interpersonal skills**.

description:
Designation: NA

Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------

#### **Job Purpose**


Job Purpose Description

#### **Job Context \& Major Challenges**


Organization Context  

Aditya Birla Finance Limited ("ABFL"), a lending subsidiary of Aditya Birla Capital Limited is among the leading well\-diversified non\-banking financial services company in India. ABFL offers customized solutions in areas of personal finance, mortgage finance, SME finance, corporate finance, wealth management, debt capital markets and loan syndication. ABFL is registered with RBI as a systemically important non\-deposit accepting non\-banking finance company (“NBFC”) and is amongst the top five largest private diversified NBFCs in India based on AUM.  

For the FY ended 31st March 2020, ABFL has a lending book of Rs. 47,075 crores, net PAT of Rs 821 Crores and net worth of 8,078 crores. The Net Interest Margin expanded by 38 bps y\-o\-y to 5\.29% and operating profit is growing at 16% y\-o\-y. ABFL’s long\-term credit rating of AAA (Stable) has been reaffirmed by ICRA. ABFL also has long\-term credit rating of AAA (Stable) by India Ratings, Perpetual debt credit rating of AA\+ (Stable) by ICRA and AA\+ (Stable) by India Ratings (Stable) and short\-term credit rating of A1\+ by ICRA \& India Ratings.  

  

Job Context  

Collections function carries out monitoring of client wise exposure and portfolio exposure to identify ‘early warning signals’ of stress and to minimize NPAs. This monitoring is done by dedicated teams who specialize in managing delinquent customers who have come under financial stress due to unfavourable market events / changes in business patterns and as well as from those customers who have intentionally stopped payment of dues with mala\-fide intentions. It also carries out overdue loan recovery from defaulting clients.  

  

This role is responsible for enhancing business profitability through effective management of the delinquent portfolio in the respective area. The incumbent will be accountable for field collections for the customers in the area. For this segment, the collections model is a combination of in\-house (for ticket sizes \>10L) and partly agency\-driven (for small ticket sizes) so the area manager will need to effectively oversee both inhouse collections officers as well as agency managers.

#### **Key Result Areas**

  

**KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)** **Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)**  


KRA1 Achieve collections targets and financial goals for the area- Monitor and Control delinquency and minimize credit losses for portfolio
  

- Drive higher resolution rates.
  

- Ensuring adequate headcount availability location\-wise / bucket\-wise / segment\-wise.
  

- Ensure Charge offs are minimized and higher recoveries from charge\-off accounts.
  

- Review, maintain control and minimize the cost incurred towards collections of dues.
  

- Daily monitoring and regular reviews of delinquent portfolio to make account level
  


KRA2 Portfolio review and monitoring- Monitor customer accounts across the region, identifying and flagging likely cases of default or delayed payment
  

- Work with non\-performing defaulting borrowers to create optimum recovery solutions
  

- Developing various MISs to show different cuts and trends in the portfolio which can lead to necessary corrective action by collections team to enhance their performance and shows area of improvement.
  

- Provide regular inputs to Management and all the other stakeholders such as Sales, Risk, Policy Team on various aspects of collections resolution and delinquency trends, Negative Areas, Negative Profile, Non\-Starters, SKIPs, Fraud Cases, etc.
  


KRA3 Vendor Management- Liaise with agencies to drive collections processes efficiently.
  

- Oversee selection processes for externa agencies
  

- Continuously monitor agency performance
  

- Exercise adequate control on agencies to ensure collection of overdue debts in a timely manner
  


KRA4 Compliance and audit- Ensure that all documentation related to the collections process is maintained in accordance with internal norms and regulatory requirements
  

- Respond to customer complaints regarding the collections process, taking steps to ensure a satisfactory outcome for both ABFL as well as its customers
  

- Plan and implement periodic audits of the collections teams, ensuring their compliance with all relevant policies and regulations
  


KRA5 Customer escalations and complaints- Coordinate with the legal team and senior management in the event of escalated cases to ensure compliance with relevant regulations
  


KRA6 People Management- Provide oversight and be a coach and mentor for the team
  

- Ensure regular functional \& behavioral trainings of team members in collaboration with HR
  

- Participate in relevant talent management and people development activities to ensure a healthy pipeline and an engaged team

We are India’s leading manufacturers \& exporters of Steel link chains for High Tensile load lifting application, we have state of the art manufacturing facility with imported machines. We have manufacturing facilities in India \& China.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a seasoned, strategic, and operations\-focused **Plant Head** to lead our manufacturing unit. The ideal candidate will have total P\&L responsibility for the plant, overseeing production, engineering, quality, maintenance, and supply chain to meet company goals. You will drive operational excellence, improve productivity, and foster a culture of safety, efficiency, and continuous improvement (Lean/TPM).

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Strategic \& Operational Leadership**

· **P\&L Accountability:** Own the overall plant P\&L, driving profitability through strict control of conversion costs, budget management, and optimal utilization of resources (man, machine, material).

· **Operational Excellence:** Formulate and execute daily, monthly, and annual production plans, ensuring 100% adherence to customer dispatch schedules and quality standards.

· **Leadership Team Management:** Lead the Plant Leadership Team (comprising Production, Quality, Maintenance, HR, Store/Purchase) to act as a cohesive unit aligned with company vision.

**2\. Manufacturing \& Engineering Excellence**

· **Process Improvement:** Drive productivity enhancement initiatives through Total Quality Management (TQM), TPM, and 5S methodologies.

· **Capacity Expansion:** Lead new project execution, tool room optimization, machine installation, and commissioning within scheduled timelines and budgets.

· **Quality Assurance:** Maintain robust quality monitoring systems (ISO, TS 16949\) to ensure zero\-defect production and minimize rejection rates.

**3\. Safety, Compliance, and Maintenance**

· **EHS Leadership:** Ensure strict compliance with Environment, Health, and Safety (EHS) standards, aiming for zero incidents.

· **Asset Care:** Implement preventive, predictive, and autonomous maintenance to maximize equipment uptime and reliability.

· **Statutory Compliance:** Ensure all legal, regulatory, and environmental compliances are adhered to.

**4\. Team Development \& Stakeholder Management**

· **Performance Management:** Set KPIs for staff, train, mentor, and build a high\-performance team to enhance productivity.

· **Industrial Relations:** Maintain a healthy industrial atmosphere, resolving worker grievances efficiently.

**Required Qualifications \& Experience**

· **Education:** B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical/Production Engineering (MBA in Operations is a plus).

· **Experience:** 15\-20\+ years of manufacturing experience, with at least 5 years as a Plant Head/Manager in a medium\-to\-heavy engineering industry.

· **Technical Knowledge:** Proficient in production in engineering products like fasteners / automotive spares or products , Handling of machines on Pneumatics / hydraulics , CNC machining, welding, assembly, and tool room operations.

· **Systems Knowledge:** Strong expertise in Lean Manufacturing, TPM, 5S, and ISO systems. (Six Sigma will be a plus)

**Desired Skills**

· Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.

· Strategic planner with strong decision\-making abilities.

· Adept at financial analysis, budgeting, and cost\-saving initiatives.

They serve as a bridge between the client and company, handling complaints, providing support, and strategically aligning services with client goals to boost business growth and loyalty. Key Responsibilities Client Engagement: Develop and nurture strong relationships with key clients, serving as the primary point of contact. Needs Assessment: Proactively understand client goals, preferences, and challenges. Problem Resolution: Address concerns, manage complaints, and ensure timely issue resolution, often escalating to relevant departments. Sales \& Growth: Identify and pursue opportunities for upselling and cross\-selling products/services. Strategy \& Feedback: Use client feedback and market research to develop retention strategies and improve service delivery. title: Area HR Partner Retail West
description:
SPEED \& SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.


**Your mission**

**Reports to:** Senior Manager HR (Retail South \& West)


**Position Summary:** The Retail HR role partners closely with retail operations to support people\-related initiatives across stores. The role focuses on driving hiring, employee engagement, capability development, and compliance while building a strong connect with store teams and supporting the overall employee experience in the region.


**Key Objectives:**

* Manage the end\-to\-end employee lifecycle for retail employees including recruitment, onboarding, engagement initiatives, training and development, and exit interviews.
* Drive hiring across retail stores by identifying and leveraging both internal and external recruitment sources to ensure timely closure of open positions.
* Partner with retail operations stakeholders and store managers to understand manpower requirements and support people\-related decisions across stores.
* Assess behavioural and capability development needs of store employees and coordinate relevant training programs with internal or external trainers.
* Plan and manage the monthly employee engagement calendar across stores to strengthen employee connect and morale.
* Coordinate and ensure timely and accurate submission of payroll inputs for retail employees.
* Conduct regular store visits to interact with employees, gather feedback, understand on\-ground challenges, and support resolution of employee concerns.
* Track attrition trends and employee feedback across stores and work with business leaders to drive retention and employee experience initiatives.
* Ensure effective implementation of company policies across stores and monitor compliance with statutory requirements, including maintenance of statutory registers and documentation.
* Actively participate in various company forums and people initiatives within the organization.

**Your talent**

**Eligibility Criteria And Functional Competencies Required:**

* MBA / PGDM students specializing in HR or related fields.
* 2–4 years of HR experience, preferably in retail, hospitality, or other customer\-facing industries.
* Prior experience in managing store hiring, employee engagement, and HR operations will be an advantage.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel and PowerPoint.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and work with multiple stakeholders.

**Our principles**

PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.


At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity \- no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people \-with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.


PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120\+ countries, and has around 22,000 employees worldwide.

title: HRIM Consultant
description:
Overview:

One Identity is an award\-winning security software provider offering a broad selection of solutions that solve some of the most common and most challenging IT security problems. Part of the One Identity Software group, One Identity solutions eliminate the complexities and time\-consuming processes often required to govern identities, manage privileged accounts and control access. Our solutions enhance business agility while addressing IAM challenges within on\-premises, cloud and hybrid environments. The combined entity delivers a complete portfolio of market\-leading Identity Access Management, Privileged Access Management, and Identity Governance solutions. Now, customers can achieve identity\-centric security with trusted, proven technology in each major category.  

The HRIS Platform Manager owns Workday HCM as the enterprise HR technology platform. This individual contributor role operates as the product owner of HR systems within IT, ensuring process integrity, clean employee data, and strong integration governance.
This role does not have direct reports.
Responsibilities:
**Platform Ownership*** Define HRIS roadmap aligned to HR leadership priorities
* Optimize hire\-to\-retire workflows
* Improve onboarding/offboarding automation

**Configuration \& Governance*** Own business process frameworks in Workday
* Manage security roles and access controls
* Maintain clean employee master data

**Integration Oversight*** Oversee integrations with:
* + Identity management systems
	+ Payroll/benefits providers
	+ Finance systems
	+ Data warehouse

**Reporting \& Compliance*** Support HR reporting needs
* Ensure compliance with audit and regulatory requirements

**Success Measures*** Accurate and timely employee data
* Seamless onboarding/offboarding experience
* Reduced HR manual administrative effort


Qualifications:
**Experience*** 5–10\+ years HRIS ownership experience
* Strong Workday HCM configuration experience
* Hands\-on experience participating in or leading Workday implementation (full lifecycle) \- Required
* Knowledge of HR business processes
* Integration and security model understanding

 **Company Description**  

One Identity enables organizations of all sizes to better secure, manage, monitor, protect, and analyze information and infrastructure to help fuel innovation and drive their businesses forward. With team members around the globe, we intend to continue to grow revenues and add value to customers.  

When you join our team, you will have the opportunity to build and develop products at a scale few others can provide. Our product portfolio serves a large base of customers, and we are addressing the strategic imperatives for enterprise businesses. Working with some of the most talented employees the industry has to offer, we provide enhanced career opportunities for team members to learn and grow in a rapidly changing environment.

title: Sr Internal Communication Manager
description:
**This role is for one of our clients**

Industry: Software Development
Seniority level: Mid\-Senior level

Min Experience: 7 years
Location: Remote (India)
JobType: full\-time

Learneo is a platform of builder\-driven businesses, including Course Hero, CliffsNotes, LitCharts, Quillbot, Symbolab, and Scribbr, all united around a shared mission of supercharging productivity and learning for everyone. We attract and scale high growth businesses built and run by visionary entrepreneurs. Each team innovates independently but has a unique opportunity to collaborate, experiment, and grow together, and they are supported by centralized corporate operations functions, including HR, Finance and Legal.


**Role Overview**  

The Senior Internal Communications Manager is responsible for helping bring the internal communications strategy to life through thoughtful planning, execution, and partnership. This role plays a key part in ensuring that employees are informed, aligned, and motivated about our strategy—primarily within QuillBot (\~80%), with additional project\-based support for Learneo Corporate (\~20%).



This person works cross\-functionally with leaders across the organization, including the QuillBot CEO, Chief of Staff, VP of HR and Learneo corporate leaders, to deliver clear, consistent, and timely communications that support business priorities and drive strategic alignment.


**Responsibilities**


* **Execute and operationalize internal communications strategy** by turning high\-level goals into clear, actionable communications across channels
* **Plan and deliver internal communications** for QuillBot, including:
	+ Company\-wide announcements and business updates
	+ Messaging and materials for Town Hall meetings, AMAs, planning, and company moments
	+ Drafting and editing communications from executive and functional leaders including strategy roll\-outs and updates, presentations, emails.
* **Contribute to communication efforts that support core business rhythms**, including onboarding, planning, and progress reporting
* **Support cross\-company communications efforts** for Learneo, including:
	+ Helping review and improve messaging for corporate communications
	+ Contributing and driving execution of project\-based communications initiatives (acquisition, re\-orgs)
* **Coordinate communications logistics and planning**, including maintaining comms calendars, aligning on timing, organizing and updating comms material for the business, and managing internal channels (e.g., Slack, email, town halls)
* **Collaborate with the People and Recruiting teams** to support communications around HR programs, benefits, and internal employer brand messaging
* **Help execute communication plans for key change initiatives**, high\-impact projects, and organizational updates
* **Ensure internal messaging reflects inclusive language and reinforces company values**, partnering with HR and leaders as needed
* **Contribute to communications planning** by sharing input and partnering with stakeholders to ensure clarity, tone, and timing are effective


**Qualifications**


* 7–15 years of experience in internal or corporate communications, ideally in high\-growth or global remote organizations
* A minimum of a Bachelor’s degree in any discipline
* Comfort advising and partnering with executives, with the judgment to handle sensitive information and maintain confidentiality
* Ability to translate complex strategies into clear, compelling communications across multiple channels (Slack, email, intranet, town halls)
* Strong track record drafting and editing executive communications, including presentations, emails, and strategy rollouts
* Experience working effectively with leaders and functions across the organization to align on messaging and communications needs
* Excellent writing, editing, and storytelling skills with a focus on clarity, tone, and inclusivity
* Familiarity with communications platforms and tools (Slack, intranets, video platforms)
* Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage calendars, timelines, and competing priorities
* High attention to detail and ability to navigate ambiguity in a fast\-paced environment


**Scope and Expectations**  

This role is focused on execution with ownership—taking initiative, managing communications with care, and contributing meaningfully to how the company communicates internally. Strategic direction is developed in collaboration with senior leaders; this role plays a critical part in executing that strategy across teams and moments. Corporate support is project\-based and primarily focused on advising and contributing to specific communications initiatives as needed.

  

**What Success Looks Like**


* Employees clearly understand the company’s strategy, current direction, and what success looks like
* Internal communications foster motivation, alignment, and a stronger sense of purpose across teams
* Leaders feel supported and confident in how messages are communicated  

The organization operates more smoothly and efficiently, with reduced friction and clearer decision\-making
* Communications contribute to faster execution and higher\-impact results across the business
* Internal messaging helps teams stay focused, move in sync, and deliver on top priorities


**Benefits \& Perks**


* Competitive salary, stock options \& annual bonus
* Medical coverage
* Life and accidental insurance
* Vacation \& leaves of absence (menstrual, flexible, special, and more!)
* Developmental opportunities through education \& developmental reimbursements \& professional workshops
* Maternity \& parental leave
* Hybrid \& remote model with flexible working hours
* On\-site \& remote company events throughout the year
* Tech \& WFH stipends \& new hire allowances
* Employee referral program
* Premium access to QuillBot

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Overview:

This role is responsible for the **day\-to\-day operational delivery and administration of employee benefits** across India, APAC, and UAE. The incumbent will ensure **accurate, timely, and compliant execution** of all benefits\-related processes while providing excellent employee support and managing external vendors.

  

The role is hands\-on and execution\-focused, requiring strong coordination skills, ownership of operational timelines, comfort working in a matrix structure, and the ability to proactively flag issues and prepare data to support decisions.


Responsibilities:

Benefits Administration \& Employee Support

* Act as the first point of contact for all employee queries related to health insurance and other benefits.
* Support employees through insurance claim processing, coordinating closely with TPAs and insurance providers.
* Manage, track, and close employee cases through AskHR (or equivalent case management system) within agreed SLAs.
* Ensure accurate benefits onboarding and offboarding, including:
* + Timely enrolment of new hires into benefits programs.
	+ Deactivation of benefits for exiting employees.
* Maintain and regularly update benefits databases and trackers to ensure data accuracy.
* Download and maintain new hire reports; send welcome emails related to benefits.
* Manage monthly meal card administration, including enrolment changes, reconciliation, and issue resolution.

  

Communication, Inductions \& Awareness

* Send timely, clear, and accurate benefits\-related communications to employees, including policy updates and changes.
* Conduct benefits induction sessions for new joiners.
* Organise and coordinate insurance refresher sessions post policy renewals.
* Support employee engagement initiatives by coordinating wellness sessions with external vendors.
* Plan and coordinate employee wellness sessions in collaboration with external vendors.


Vendor Coordination \& Internal Stakeholders

* Act as the operational interface with TPAs, insurance companies, brokers, and other benefits vendors.
* Coordinate with vendors to resolve day\-to\-day operational issues, escalations, and service delays.
* Participate in negotiations with insurance providers/broker to optimize cost and coverage.
* Engage with Finance, Payroll, HR Operations, and other internal teams to ensure smooth benefits processing.
* Track invoices, validate billing, and ensure timely submission for payments in line with internal processes.
* Escalate critical issues promptly with clear context and data.

  

Renewals \& Ongoing Operations

* Support execution of insurance policy renewals across India, APAC, and UAE by:
* + Compiling claims data and utilisation reports.
	+ Coordinating required information with brokers and insurers.
	+ Supporting renewal timelines and administrative requirements.
* Participate in renewal discussions primarily from an operational and data\-preparation perspective, rather than ownership of strategy or design.
* Recommend improvements to benefits programs based on market trends and internal insights.

  

Reporting, Data \& Documentation

* Pull and consolidate operational reports (new hires, claims, vendor SLAs, query volumes).
* Maintain standard operating documentation related to benefits processes and vendor contacts
* Ensure benefits processes are executed accurately, on time, and in accordance with policy.
* Identify recurring issues or risks and flag them proactively with supporting data.
* Review employee feedback and benchmarking reports to enhance benefits design.


Qualifications:
**Key Skills \& Capabilities**

* Strong hands\-on experience in **benefits operations and administration**.
* Excellent **coordination and follow‑through** skills.
* Comfortable working in a **matrix reporting environment** with multiple stakeholders.
* Clear, empathetic, and effective **employee communication** skills.
* Strong **vendor coordination and escalation management** ability.
* Detail\-oriented, structured, and process\-driven.
* Ability to pull together data, spot trends, and support operational decision\-making.
* Self\-starter with a **proactive, ownership\-driven mindset**.

 **Experience \& Qualifications**

* 2–4 years of experience in **Benefits Administration, HR Operations, or Total Rewards Operations**.
* Prior experience working with **insurance providers, brokers, and TPAs** is desirable.
* Exposure to benefits operations is strongly preferred.
* Experience using HR systems, case management tools, and Excel\-based trackers.
* Bachelor’s degree required; HR or operations\-related certifications are a plus.

 **What Success Looks Like in This Role**

* Seamless, issue\-free benefits operations throughout the maternity cover period.
* Employee queries resolved efficiently with high satisfaction.
* Renewals and vendor processes executed on time with minimal escalations.
* Strong operational grip with proactive flagging of issues and dependencies.


What do we offer:

Please submit resume/CV in English.  

All resumes are held in confidence. Only candidates whose profiles closely match requirements will be contacted during this search.  

  

HireRight does not accept unsolicited resumes through or from search firms or staffing agencies. All unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of HireRight and HireRight will not be obligated to pay a placement fee.

* Ensure all candidate submissions comply with client and legal requirements.

* Proficiency in Boolean search and resume mining.
* Familiarity with US tax terms and visa classifications.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong negotiation and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment.
* High level of attention to detail and organizational skills.

* Number of qualified submissions per week.
* Interview\-to\-placement ratio.

* Supportive and growth\-oriented work environment.
